features: Track Your Water Intake Throughout the Day: Aqulea's daily water intake bottle with time markers and encouraging quote reminders will help you boost your daily water intake. Stay motivated and hydrated with our BPA-free 32oz water bottle with measurements

Your Ultimate Hydration Partner: Our clear glass drinking bottle are made of borosilicate glass, which is dishwasher safe, leak proof, BPA, BPS, PVC, lead, and cadmium free. These durable and aesthetic reusable glass time water bottles will not crack under extreme temperature and pressure

Innovative and Convenient: The Aqulea wide mouth water bottle glass package comes with a leak-proof glass bottle with bamboo lid, a non-slip protective silicone sleeve for easy grip and maximum impact protection, an 18/8 stainless steel strainer for infusion water bottle, and a retractable brush

Functional Design: The wide mouth of the fruit water bottle infuser makes it easy to wash with a retractable bottle brush; we've attached a strap to the lid of the hourly time 32 ounce water bottle tracker so you can conveniently carry and refill it for daily goal tracking

Aqulea's Satisfaction Policy: Please let us know if anything in the package is broken, if the glass bottles break accidentally, or if the lid develops a problem within the first 90 days. We'll replace it to make sure you're happy with our water tracker bottle
